case.title: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH. Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor. Need: 30000 kits a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 5 days). Fallback if you walk away: today's terms continue unchanged. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our offer for your consideration. We can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months.

As a valued partner, we always strive to support your operations with our extensive inventory and reliable delivery service. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our successful business relationship and standing by as your trusted partner for all your supply needs.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

You offered us a steady supply with reliable delivery. Our options put the whole fastener kit under one agreement with your firm, with a binding volume that gives your plant one planned load.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives Leitner & Sohn the longest planning horizon and a firm yearly volume, and the claims below show why the price can stay where it is.

On the cost side:
Our forecast for Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc rises 6.0% (fc:360010@2026-09).

On our order history for the bolt:
Our orders of Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2025-05-26 (po:4500012506-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013479-10) and EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-09-30 (po:4500014475-10): the price has been unchanged.

On our order history for the nut:
Our orders of Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-20), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2025-06-02 (po:4500012538-10), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-01-30 (po:4500013504-10) and EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-10): the price has been unchanged.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.86; payment 45 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.91; payment 90 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.88; payment 60 days net; contract term 36 months.
Binding volume in every option: 30,000 units a year over 36 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Since you may need to take this further internally, please bring Option A to the person who decides on your side. For them it means one binding yearly volume across the whole kit, a long contract term and a single agreement with a long-standing customer, and it needs no further steps from us once confirmed.

We would like to settle this as a fair solution for both family companies.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As Inside Sales, I am fully authorized to negotiate and conclude this agreement with you directly. 

Our current offer is a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. 

We welcome the 36-month contract term and the 45-day payment period proposed in your Option A. While historical prices for individual components have been stable, the bundled kit requires a sustainable calculation, allowing us to offer €5.58 per unit for this package. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €5.58 per unit. As an alternative package, we offer a price of €5.58 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.95; payment 45 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.00; payment 90 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.97; payment 60 days net; contract term 36 months.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives Leitner & Sohn the longest planning horizon and a firm yearly volume, and the price history above shows why the price can stay where Option A puts it.

Since you can conclude this directly, please take Option A up with whoever in your firm signs off on pricing, so that your answer is simple. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
